title: 句间逻辑连接
goal: 按句间关系选择连接表达；区分连词与连接副词的句法用法。

points.label: 按句间关系选择连接表达
区分连词与连接副词的句法用法

sources.title: 大学英语六级（CET-6）：课表
sources.used: 写作部分本课的内容范围、知识点与练习规格

body.p: 连接词表明两句之间的关系，但不能代替论据。先判断是补充、因果、转折、让步还是举例。再看这个连接词后面接分句还是名词短语。

body.box: The recording was unclear because the microphone was covered. The microphone was covered; therefore, the recording was unclear.

body.p: because 引出原因从句。therefore 放在独立分句里，引出结果。therefore 前面只用逗号是错的，要用句号或分号把两个分句隔开。

cards.title: 补充与因果
rows: in addition
补充另一项相关信息。
The cover protects the pages. In addition, it holds a reference card.
moreover
补充支持同一方向的理由。
The stand is adjustable. Moreover, it folds for storage.
furthermore
再补充一条同方向的论证。
The plan identifies tasks. Furthermore, it assigns responsibility.
also
添加信息，常放在实义动词前。
The manual also explains routine maintenance.
because
后接原因分句。主句前不再加 so。
Because the path was blocked, the delivery took a different route.
therefore
引出由前文推出的结果或判断。
The seal was broken; therefore, the parcel required inspection.
as a result
连接副词短语，引出结果。
The label detached. As a result, the box could not be identified.
consequently
连接副词，说明后果。
The screen failed; consequently, the display was postponed.

cards.title: 转折与让步
rows: however
转折副词，用在独立分句里。它不是连词。
The draft is detailed. However, its conclusion is unclear.
in contrast
对照不同对象的特征。
The entrance is wide. In contrast, the inner passage is narrow.
by contrast
说明与前述对象的差异。
The old lid was rigid. By contrast, the new one bends easily.
on the other hand
提出另一面，两面不必完全相反。
The room is central. On the other hand, it offers little privacy.
although
让步从句后面要有主句。
Although the surface looks dry, the layer beneath remains damp.
even though
承认一个事实，主句写出与预期相反的情况。
Even though the route is short, the steep steps make it difficult.
even if
即使假设的条件成立，主句的判断也不变。
Even if the price falls, the item will still require storage space.
nevertheless
承认前面的困难，再给出另一判断。
The instructions are brief. Nevertheless, they cover the essential checks.

cards.title: 举例表达
rows: for example
引出一个完整的例句，例子要支持前面的判断。
Small changes can improve access. For example, a lower handle can be easier to reach.
for instance
用法同 for example，引出例子。
Some tasks need a record. For instance, loaned items need a return date.
such as
后接名词或名词短语，不接完整分句。
The cabinet holds supplies such as labels and envelopes.
to illustrate
用一个实例说明前面的观点。
A clear sequence reduces uncertainty. To illustrate, a numbered diagram shows which part fits first.

cards.title: 句法与标点
rows: 原因从句
because 后接主谓结构。从句放在句首时，后面加逗号。
Because the file was incomplete, the editor requested clarification.
结果分句
therefore 前用句号或分号，只用逗号是错的。
The file was incomplete; therefore, the editor requested clarification.
让步从句
although 连接从句和主句，不再加 but。
Although the sample is small, it reveals an inconsistency.
转折分句
however 前后都是独立分句时，前面用句号或分号。
The sample is small. However, it reveals an inconsistency.

body.box: A neighborhood studio has introduced a booking calendar. The calendar shows when each room is free. In addition, it records the equipment assigned to each reservation. This second function adds useful information; it is not a consequence of room availability. The system is convenient. However, it still needs accurate entries from staff. If an entry is wrong, the calendar may display a room as available when it is already occupied. Convenience therefore does not remove the need for checking.

Which relation does In addition mark?
1. A consequence of showing room availability
2. A contrast between available and occupied rooms
3. An example of an inaccurate reservation
4. Another function of the same calendar

body.p: In addition 后面是 records the equipment，这是日历的另一项功能，对应第四项。However 引出限制，therefore 引出由前文得出的判断。

items.stem: A directory lists contacts. It gives opening hours as another feature. Which connector fits: The directory lists contacts. ___, it gives opening hours.
options: In addition
As a result
In contrast
Nevertheless
items.why: another feature 表示补充，用 In addition，即第一项。

items.stem: The drawer jammed, preventing access to the spare clips. Which relation fits before the consequence?
options: For instance
As a result
On the other hand
Furthermore
items.why: preventing access 是 jammed 的结果，用 As a result，即第二项。

items.stem: Which version uses because without repeating the causal connection?
options: Because the receipt was missing, so the clerk requested another copy.
The receipt was missing, because, the clerk requested another copy.
Because the receipt was missing, the clerk requested another copy.
Because the receipt was missing. The clerk requested another copy.
items.why: because 从句后直接接主句，即第三项。第一项多加了 so。

items.stem: Which version correctly connects two independent clauses using however?
options: The cover is attractive, however, the binding needs repair.
However the cover is attractive, the binding needs repair.
The cover is attractive however the binding needs repair.
The cover is attractive; however, the binding needs repair.
items.why: however 不能单独连接两个独立分句。第四项用分号隔开，however 后加逗号。

items.stem: Use the connector meaning “an additional point” that begins with in: The poster gives the date. ___, it names the venue.
items.why: 日期和地点是并列的两条信息，用 in addition 表示补充。

items.stem: Use the two-word example marker beginning with for: Simple checks can reveal defects. ___, a loose handle may be noticed before use.
items.why: for example 与 for instance 均可引出该实例。

items.stem: Use because or therefore: ___ the switch was damaged, the lamp did not respond.
items.why: 空后是原因从句，逗号后的主句给出结果，所以用 because。

items.stem: Use although or however: The label is faded; ___, the reference number is still readable.
items.why: 分号后是独立分句，用 however。用 although，分号后就只剩一个从句。

items.stem: A plan provides a timetable and, as a separate benefit, identifies the responsible staff. Which connector expresses that addition?
options: Furthermore
Consequently
Nevertheless
In contrast
items.why: as a separate benefit 表示补充，即第一项 Furthermore。

items.stem: A general claim says that physical records can preserve useful information. A diary is then named as a particular case. Which connector fits?
options: Therefore
For instance
On the other hand
Nevertheless
items.why: a particular case 表示实例，用 For instance，即第二项。

items.stem: Which sentence correctly links a damaged sign to the resulting confusion without duplicating connectors?
options: Because the sign was damaged, so visitors could not identify the entrance from the main path.
The sign was damaged, therefore, visitors could not identify the entrance from the main path.
Because the sign was damaged, visitors could not identify the entrance from the main path.
Because the sign was damaged. Visitors could not identify the entrance from the main path.
items.why: because 从句后接主句，组成完整的句子，即第三项。第一项多加了 so。

items.stem: Which revision preserves the contrast and uses however correctly between independent clauses?
options: Although the proposal reduces travel, however, it requires additional coordination between the separate teams involved.
The proposal reduces travel, however, it requires additional coordination between the separate teams involved.
The proposal reduces travel however it requires additional coordination between the separate teams involved.
The proposal reduces travel; however, it requires additional coordination between the separate teams involved.
items.why: 第四项用分号隔开两个独立分句，however 表示转折。第二项只用逗号，是错的。

items.stem: Use the three-word result marker beginning with as: The fastening broke during transport. ___, the contents shifted inside the package and needed inspection.
items.why: the contents shifted 是 fastening broke 的后果，用 as a result。

items.stem: Use the four-word contrast marker beginning with on: The extension adds useful floor space. ___, it leaves less room for the outdoor waiting area.
items.why: 前句说扩建增加了室内空间，后句说室外等候区变小。on the other hand 引出另一面。

items.stem: Use although or however: ___ the proposed route is direct, it passes through a narrow entrance that may slow the delivery team.
items.why: although 从句后接逗号和主句。however 不能这样连接两个分句。

items.stem: Use because or therefore: The samples were stored without labels; ___, the technician could not reliably match each sample to its recorded source.
items.why: 分号后是结果，用 therefore。用 because，后半句就成了缺少主句的原因从句。
